question: The successful reintroduction of the Great Indian Bustard into the wild in 2025 was reported from which national park?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Desert National Park**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Desert National Park** is located in the western Indian state of **Rajasthan**, near the towns of **Jaisalmer** and **Barmer**.
 
• It is one of the largest national parks in India, covering an area of about **3162 square kilometers**.
